definitions: The process or technique of selecting, editing, and piecing together separate sections of film, video, or sound to form a continuous whole.
A sequence of short shots, especially in a film or television program, used to condense space, time, or information.
A composite picture or artwork created by combining several separate pictures or elements.
examples: The film featured several powerful montages.
Her art exhibition included striking photo montages.
The director used montages to show the passage of time.
